target.title: fix(gateway): reduce mcp loopback schema warning noise
target.body:
Closes #98437

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators would see noisy MCP loopback schema warnings when union variants repeat the same field schema as separately allocated objects. Those false-positive `conflicting schema definitions` lines made gateway logs harder to scan and could still be double-counted by the console-capture/file-log path because the old `mcp loopback:` prefix did not route through the subsystem logger.

## Why This Change Was Made

The MCP loopback schema flattener now treats structurally identical property schemas as equivalent before deciding that a repeated union field is a real conflict. Genuine schema conflicts still keep the existing first-variant behavior and still warn once through the existing lifecycle-scoped dedupe.

This also switches MCP loopback warning prefixes to `mcp-loopback:` so remaining diagnostics use the subsystem logger path instead of the generic dual-write path.

## User Impact

Operators should see fewer false-positive MCP loopback warning lines in gateway logs. For structurally identical repeated schemas, the warning count goes from one warning per `(tool, field)` conflict to zero; for remaining real warnings, the subsystem-prefixed logger path is covered to emit one matching file-log line instead of a duplicated console-capture/file-log path.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/gateway/mcp-http.test.ts src/gateway/mcp-http.schema.test.ts src/logging/console-capture.test.ts` -> pass: 8 Gateway test files / 296 tests and 1 logging test file / 15 tests.
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/gateway/mcp-http.schema.ts src/gateway/mcp-http.test.ts src/gateway/mcp-http.ts src/logging/console-capture.test.ts` -> pass.
- `git diff --check` -> pass.
- `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 pnpm check:changed --base upstream/main --timed` -> pass for `core, coreTests` lanes.
- `pnpm build` -> pass on the rebased branch.

AI-assisted: implemented with Codex. I reviewed the touched Gateway/logging paths and understand the change.

Signed-off-by: Ho Lim <subhoya@gmail.com>
